stations.title: Sefton
stations.say: How can two lines take the night?

stations.title: Match step
stations.text: Searches all customers for every order.

stations.title: Money step
stations.text: Gets the same matched orders as before.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Sefton cannot see how his two-line match step takes so long.
For every order it goes through the customer list from the front.
You look each customer up from something built once, and do the same for trade orders.
Now the match step gives the same orders as before, in a small part of the time.
Same report, same answers, and work that only doubles when the shop does.
